caption: Family D compares two cost models, not contention isolation: an opaque eight-rank NCCL-table measurement scaled by rank versus direct all-pairs packet transfers on a Clos. Both request the dense fallback's generic half-precision all-gather plus reduce-scatter element count. EP 8 has no cross-node contention; EP 256 is a post-specified unscored diagnostic. Family S compares the dense fallback with sparse routed FP8 dispatch plus BF16 combine.
